image_description: A close-up photograph of a large male common iguana perched on rocks near water. The iguana exhibits distinct breeding coloration with an orange/tan head and neck, transitioning to a dark brown/black body with lighter banding. A prominent serrated dorsal crest runs down the spine. The background consists of blurred water and rocks.
